result.summary: The page is largely intact; the main visible defect is a meaningless '-0%' discount badge on the lower restaurant card. Clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card were treated as expected scroll/viewport behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a '-0%' promotional badge, which is meaningless and looks like a broken discount value rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0%, or render a valid value/label such as a positive percentage, 'Free delivery', or no badge at all.
